subject: Pipeline data accuracy: SKU & probability sweep
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline data accuracy: SKU & probability sweep

Team —

Quick ask before Monday finance review: I ran a short audit on our open opportunities for Acme Corp (deal RDW-4721) and flagged ~7 rows where the CRM fields look inconsistent and will materially move our forecast if left as-is. Can we split the work and get updates to the canonical fields below by EOD Tuesday? Finance needs clean inputs for Wednesday’s commit review.

Fields to normalize (please use the attached pipeline_cleanup_template.csv as the import format):
- Amount: verify contract value and round to nearest whole USD (no commas)
- Product/SKU: pick from the official SKU list (see acme_sku_mapping_v1.xlsx)
- Next step: one-line next action (e.g., "PO received pending signature")
- Probability: set to best-estimate (10/30/60/80/95) with a one-line rationale in notes
- Expected close date: verify and push only if confirmed by customer

Initial assignments: Marissa — top 3 late-stage rows (Opp IDs 3742, 3801, 3843); Lauren — mid-stage pull (3788, 3790); Karthik — confirmation of SKU mapping and probability rationale across all flagged rows.

Let me know any blockers. I’ll consolidate updates into a single CSV and re-import to HubSpot.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Thanks Sergio — I’m picking up 3742 / 3801 / 3843 now. Two quick clarifications before I make changes:

1) Opp 3742 shows Amount $124,500 in CRM but the latest quote on Drive lists $99,900 (see link). Which number should be canonical? Customer mentioned a scope reduction in last call.
2) For Opp 3801 the Product column is free-text "LARGE-ENG" — should that map to SKU-RI-Large-v2 or SKU-RI-Enterprise? Karthik, can you confirm mapping guidance?

If I don't hear back in an hour I’ll mark Opp 3742 as $99,900 (per quote) and set probability to 60% with note: "scope confirmed reduced — awaiting PO".

-Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the read. Use the quote for 3742 ($99,900) — we lost the add-on that was inflating ARR. Please add a note: "customer confirmed scope reduction on 2027-04-15 call; quote attached."

Karthik — mapping guidance below (short):
- "LARGE-ENG" -> SKU-RI-Enterprise (SKU-RI-Enterprise includes multi-region tokens and priority throughput)
- "CORE" or blank -> SKU-RI-Core-v1
- Any mention of "dedicated" -> SKU-RI-Dedicated-Base

If any runner-up cases, flag to me and I’ll ping customer for confirmation. I’ll attach acme_sku_mapping_v1.xlsx to the consolidated import.

Sergio

Hi Dana —

Cutting to the chase: finance is cleaning our forecast for the Acme renewal and we want to confirm two small points so we can reflect accurate numbers in next week’s internal commit. Can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?

1) Opp 3742: final contract value — our latest signed quote shows $99,900 after the scope reduction on April 15. Is that the correct amount we should expect on the PO?
2) Expected close timing: are you still targeting "end of May" or has the timeline slipped?

If helpful I can share the one-page summary we’ll send to finance. No need for a long reply — a one-line confirm for each item is perfect.

Thanks for the quick read,

All updates are in — I finished the import and validated changes against HubSpot. Summary:
- Opp 3742: Amount set to 99900, SKU -> SKU-RI-Enterprise, Probability -> 60% (note added: "per customer quote 2027-04-15").
- Opp 3801: SKU-RI-Enterprise assigned after Karthik confirmation.
- Opp 3843: Expected close moved to 2027-05-26 (confirmed by Marissa).
- Mid-stage opps (3788, 3790): normalized product to SKU-RI-Core-v1; probabilities updated to 30% and 10% respectively.
